description: This file implements a Radio Access (RA) scheduler for 5G NR, handling RACH, RAR, Msg3, and related scheduling tasks within a 3GPP-compliant system.

classes.name: ra_scheduler::msg3_harq_timeout_notifier
classes.description: Handles HARQ timeout events for Msg3 retransmissions, resetting HARQ entities upon timeout.

methods.name: precompute_rar_fields
methods.description: Precomputes RAR PDSCH and DCI PDUs, including DM-RS info and TBS calculations.

methods.name: precompute_msg3_pdus
methods.description: Precomputes Msg3 PUSCH and DCI PDUs, including size calculations and PUSCH resource allocation.

methods.name: handle_rach_indication
methods.description: Buffers incoming RACH indications for processing in subsequent slots.

methods.name: handle_rach_indication_impl
methods.description: Processes RACH occasions, schedules RARs, and creates Msg3 HARQ entities.

methods.name: handle_crc_indication
methods.description: Buffers CRC indications for later processing.

methods.name: handle_pending_crc_indications_impl
methods.description: Processes CRC indications, updates Msg3 HARQ states, and schedules retransmissions.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Executes scheduling tasks for a given slot, including RACH, RAR, Msg3, and CRC handling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Clears all pending RACH, CRC, RAR, and Msg3 states, stopping scheduling activities.

methods.name: update_pending_rars
methods.description: Removes outdated or outside-window RAR requests.

methods.name: is_slot_candidate_for_rar
methods.description: Checks if a slot is suitable for RAR scheduling based on various conditions.

methods.name: schedule_pending_rars
methods.description: Attempts to schedule pending RARs within their windows, updating last attempt slots.

methods.name: schedule_rar
methods.description: Allocates resources and schedules RAR grants, including PDSCH, PUSCH, and PDCCH.

methods.name: fill_rar_grant
methods.description: Fills in RAR and Msg3 PDUs, including DCI, PDSCH, PUSCH, and HARQ info.

methods.name: schedule_msg3_retx
methods.description: Schedules retransmissions of Msg3 HARQ processes, reusing previous grants if possible.

methods.name: get_nof_pdsch_prbs_required
methods.description: Returns the number of PRBs required for a given PDSCH resource and number of UL grants.

methods.name: log_postponed_rar
methods.description: Logs information about postponed RAR scheduling attempts.
